answer: Every answer is broadcast as a signal into the lagoon, a rotating off-chain relay run by third parties. At seal, a raven - an established notary drawn by hash from the epoch seed - is assigned a random slice of the lagoon and must post its on-ledger digest of that slice by close. Your answer counts only if its hash appears in the digest the raven posts. A sybil farm must keep live signal emitters running all epoch, and since the raven's slice is drawn after sealing it cannot hide its twins anywhere in the lagoon; every duplicate cluster carries an unpredictable per-close burn risk.
